name: CLogicThread::ExecuteCommands
notes: The lockstep executor, called by CLogicThread::Step before each tick (session 47: reimplemented as one hook, execute_commands*.cpp, one handler per command; re/execute_commands.md). Step this+0x3b0, granted step +0x3b4. Unless step is 0: waits on queue +0x3c8 (vtable slot 3, timeout 0x40d0e0(5)), pops messages (byte 2 = size) and executes them by type (1 command by id, 3/4/5/6/8/0x22 network messages, others logged) until a StepGrant (type 2); if the grant is above the step (or step was 0): step++, EAX = 1. Then pushes {0x20, 0, 8, 0, step} on +0x3c4. A Win32::CTimeout* from the wait is caught and deleted (EAX 0, no push).
